title: Playing for dancers rather than concerts, and California with Bill
summary: He prefers dance jobs, which require all kinds of tempos including waltzes, and recalls three weeks in a California club with Bill Bessonet.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
